targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN userinterface_name = 'stb_android_mobile' THEN device_name END) as "Android Mobile Devices",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN userinterface_name = 'stb_tv' THEN device_name END) as "STB TV Devices",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN userinterface_name = 'example_gui' THEN device_name END) as "IAD GUI Devices",
  COUNT(DISTINCT device_name) as "Total Devices",
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(metadata->'info'->>'serial_number_stb', metadata->'info'->>'seriennummer_stb')) as "Unique Serials",
  COUNT(*) as "Total Scans",
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(metadata->'info'->>'software_version', metadata->'info'->>'softwareversion')) as "Firmware Versions"
FROM (SELECT * FROM script_results WHERE ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = script_results.host_name AND df.device_name = script_results.device_name AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ',')))) script_results 
WHERE script_name IN ('get_info', 'device_get_info')
  AND success::text IN ($success)
  AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND ('${user_interface:csv}' = '' OR userinterface_name = ANY(string_to_array('${user_interface:csv}', ',')))
  AND ('${host:csv}' = '' OR host_name = ANY(string_to_array('${host:csv}', ',')))
  AND ('${device_name:csv}' = '' OR device_name = ANY(string_to_array('${device_name:csv}', ',')))
  AND (COALESCE(metadata->>'variant', 'Base') IN (${variant:sqlstring}))

SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_name) device_name as "Device", userinterface_name as "User Interface", host_name as "Host", COALESCE(metadata->>'variant', 'base') as "Variant", ci.info as "Device Info (JSON)", started_at as "Last Scanned", ROUND(execution_time_ms::decimal / 1000, 1) as "Duration (s)", ('report') as "Report" FROM (SELECT * FROM script_results WHERE ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = script_results.host_name AND df.device_name = script_results.device_name AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ',')))) sr LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (sr.metadata->'info') || COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(o.info_key, to_jsonb(o.corrected_value)), '{}'::jsonb) AS info FROM device_info_overrides o WHERE o.team_id = sr.team_id AND o.device_name = sr.device_name AND o.host_name = sr.host_name AND o.userinterface_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(sr.userinterface_name, '') ) ci ON true WHERE script_name IN ('get_info', 'device_get_info') AND success::text IN ($success) AND ci.info IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(started_at) AND ('${user_interface:csv}' = '' OR userinterface_name = ANY(string_to_array('${user_interface:csv}', ','))) AND ('${host:csv}' = '' OR host_name = ANY(string_to_array('${host:csv}', ','))) AND ('${device_name:csv}' = '' OR device_name = ANY(string_to_array('${device_name:csv}', ','))) AND (COALESCE(metadata->>'variant', 'Base') IN (${variant:sqlstring})) ORDER BY device_name, started_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_name) device_name as "Device", userinterface_name as "UI", host_name as "Host", COALESCE(metadata->>'variant', 'base') as "Variant", ci.info->>'build_version' as "Build Version", ci.info->>'hardware_version' as "HW Version", COALESCE(ci.info->>'software_version', ci.info->>'softwareversion') as "SW Version", COALESCE(ci.info->>'serial_number_stb', ci.info->>'seriennummer_stb') as "Serial STB", COALESCE(ci.info->>'application_version', ci.info->>'anwendungsversion') as "App Version", started_at as "Last Scanned", ROUND(execution_time_ms::decimal / 1000, 1) as "Duration (s)", ('report') as "Report" FROM (SELECT * FROM script_results WHERE ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = script_results.host_name AND df.device_name = script_results.device_name AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ',')))) sr LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (sr.metadata->'info') || COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(o.info_key, to_jsonb(o.corrected_value)), '{}'::jsonb) AS info FROM device_info_overrides o WHERE o.team_id = sr.team_id AND o.device_name = sr.device_name AND o.host_name = sr.host_name AND o.userinterface_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(sr.userinterface_name, '') ) ci ON true WHERE script_name IN ('get_info', 'device_get_info') AND success::text IN ($success) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) AND ('${user_interface:csv}' = '' OR userinterface_name = ANY(string_to_array('${user_interface:csv}', ','))) AND ('${host:csv}' = '' OR host_name = ANY(string_to_array('${host:csv}', ','))) AND ('${device_name:csv}' = '' OR device_name = ANY(string_to_array('${device_name:csv}', ','))) AND (COALESCE(metadata->>'variant', 'Base') IN (${variant:sqlstring})) AND userinterface_name = 'stb_tv' ORDER BY device_name, started_at DESC

list.label: User Interface
list.name: user_interface
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT userinterface_name FROM script_results WHERE script_name IN ('get_info', 'device_get_info') AND userinterface_name IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY userinterface_name

list.label: Host
list.name: host
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT host_name FROM script_results WHERE script_name IN ('get_info', 'device_get_info') AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY host_name

list.label: Device Name
list.name: device_name
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT device_name FROM script_results WHERE script_name IN ('get_info', 'device_get_info') AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY device_name

list.label: Variant
list.description: Run scope. 'Base' = run with no --variant. Each named variant is recorded separately on script_results.metadata->>'variant'.
list.name: variant
list.query: SELECT 'Base' AS variant UNION SELECT name FROM userinterface_variants UNION SELECT DISTINCT metadata->>'variant' FROM script_results WHERE metadata->>'variant' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY variant

list.description: Filter by device tags set on the Device page
list.label: Tag
list.name: flag
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT f AS flag FROM device_flags, unnest(flags) f ORDER BY 1
